# FG-DB-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`append-only-violation`](../../ops/runbooks/append-only-violation.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_update_of_an_append_only_table_is_append_only_violation` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データの保護の仕組みが働きました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A data protection safeguard was triggered. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pengaman perlindungan data terpicu. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

An append-only safeguard of the database (ADR-0018) failed: a guard trigger rejected an UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE of an append-only table (SQLSTATE XF001 — a bug or a manual change), forge doctor found a guard missing or weakened (a role attribute, a membership, a trigger or event trigger not enabled ALWAYS, a function's owner or privilege, the bootstrap version), the DDL log has an unexpected change, or the members of forge_owner / forge_seq / forge_purge differ from database.privileged_members.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason`: rejected (with `query`, `sqlstate=XF001` and `db_message` naming the operation and table), guard_missing (with `guard`: bootstrap_version, role_attributes, role_separation, log_triggers, event_triggers, function_owner, function_privilege, app_login), unexpected_ddl, role_membership_changed (with `unexpected` / `missing` role names). Run `forge doctor --json` (read-only) and compare the db.bootstrap check with ops/db/bootstrap/; read forge.ddl_audit for the time of the change.

## 対処 (fix)

rejected: find the caller named by `query` — append-only tables are changed only by their owning functions. guard_missing: re-run the bootstrap files (an approved runbook step) or restore the privilege. role_membership_changed: revoke the unexpected membership or add the role to database.privileged_members after review.
